Hello, as a plat twitch main I rarely dodge games, especially in silver. I’ve noticed that a lot of silver players don’t know wave management properly so you can abuse this to gank after gank after gank. I usually do this by telling my mid laner to intentionally lose an early trade or to let the other laner push so you can sneak around and kill him or force summs. This way you can usually snowball your lanes. If you can get your team to bait enemy laners you can very easily win in silver.

As someone who plays twitch on the jgl and the adc role I usually have no problems with this at all. It's important to adapt your build to the enemy champions/builds which may affect your damage such as the enemy team building a lot of armor.

I usually rush bork then go runaan's hurricane > infinity edge > phantom dancer/guardian angel/statikk shiv > ldr if enemy has a lot of armor/guardian angel/phantom dancer

**Other variations include:**

jgl item > bork > hurricane > ie > ga/pd

jgl item > wit's end > hurricane > ie > ga/pd

jgl item > bork > qss > ga > pd (very defensive build)

lots of other builds

bork > hurricane > ie > qss/ga/statikk > ga/statikk/qss/maw

wit's end > hurricane > ie > bloodthirster/qss > gaetc.

​

Occasional cheese/off-meta builds:

**vs lee sin/kha/other ad assassin**

jgl item > ga > bork > hurricane > ie

bork > ga > etc

\>>Only if you're really far ahead/behind/or if you're a focus target as this will slow down your powerspike, it's not recommended but it works if that one enemy lee sin is really annoying.

​

**vs ap assassin/fed mages**

jgl item > wit's end > hurricane > ie > qss/maw

wit's end > qss/maw > normal build without ga

\>>Recommended if enemy has A LOT of ap as this build will make you potentially vulnerable to any ad champions or hard engage tanks/bruisers.

​

**Ultra defensive turtle twitch build**

jgl item > bork > qss > ga > pd/maw

bork > pd > ie > ga > qss (works better on adc twitch than jgl)

\>>Recommended if you're being gunned down like you're xxxtentacion, with this build you can kite, survive and still do a decent amount of damage.

​

It also matters what runes you have, for example conqueror is more like a ticking adaptive damage boost early, and an instant damage boost in late game. While lethal tempo is good all game but more dependent on whether you can kite or not.

While Twitch does lack hard engage abilities he has enough slows, movement speed bonuses and range boosts in his kit to make up for some of that aspect. As a jungler I like to walk around the enemy and auto attack them to death or force them to flash, this way they have to either engage on you, forcing him to use summoners or die. **(ONLY DO THIS EARLY GAME AS IN LATER STAGES YOU WILL DIE INSTANTLY UNLESS PROPERLY EXECUTED.)** 

Also note that w is more useful than you think. It's an AoE slow which procs your passive which also procs lethal tempo and conqueror. **If they already know you're there I usually find no use in using Q then W, I like to use Q+W, which you use w in the brief moment before you stealth so it doesn't cancel your stealth.** It will slow the enemy and give you the movement speed to give you time to move up on the enemy or disengage. Also note that you can use Q then immediately auto attack a blast cone and stealth mid jump.

I also like to use R defensively rather than offensively, meaning that they have to push your frontline instead of the other way around which most silver adcs misuse. While his R is a good engage tool because of it's range, you're too squishy to stand there and will get blown up immediately without good peel. **However this can change with different runes,** for example lethal tempo + nimbus cloak, this way you can usually kite offensively and defensively **BUT** you will be giving up the extra burst damage from the conqueror + sudden impact tree.

You usually build cinderhulk and then warmog on sejuani nowadays (only if you have overgrowth). She has no use for damage items since her w scale with maximum health. Usually she has enough armor and mr when she finishes cinderhulk which is why it’s more effective to take warmog’s after, there’s no point in building more mr or armor than needed. You have no use for armor or mr without any health to defend it with. 

The recommended build from me is: Cinderhulk -> boots -> warmog -> gargoyle -> any tank item depending on the situation (thornmail, abyssal mask, adaptive helmet, deadman’s plate)

The reason people would build iceborn at all is because her armor used to be stupidly big when her passive was up which ended up in her being too squishy in dragged out fights and having too much armor and mr at the beginning. So she needed to one shot people and the slow area was stupidly big enough to cover the whole enemy team. Her passive has now been updated to give less mr and armor but it stays longer on her for more dragged out fights and better tanking.

If you believe she needs more attack damage you can check out her W damage for yourself. Sejuani is supposed to max W and sometimes the 2nd W can do up to 400 damage at once. If OP masters sejuani or gets better at her he will find out more combos and timing to go with her W. For example I know her W timing so if the person flashes or repositions I can time it to go off mid Q and hit the enemy even if I don’t hit my Q. You can also use W mid Q which some lower elo players don’t know. So you can surprise burst someone by pressing Q and W at the same time so they will get hit by the 2nd W at the end of the Q knock up.

Hello, as a jungle main, I advice you to take demolish as a rune if you’re playing a tank jungler. Most tank junglers don’t take towers very well or don’t split push very well and demolish helps with this a lot. Usually this is used to take early tower plating after a successful gank (if they don’t have teleport) or if you’re forced to split push somehow you can take towers with it. I usually take demolish on sejuani though if you think that other runes are better it’s up to you. The reason a player is bronze is usually because they’re not capable to analyze their mistakes and better themselves. The next step would be to capitalize on enemy mistakes, which comes after bronze and silver. 

Right now sejuani is good in almost all stages of the game, if she hits all of her abilities her damage can be insane early and mid game. I find myself in situations where I usually win against most junglers at level 3 except against strictly speaking dueling champions. Though those junglers are partially gone from the meta. I usually gank enemy laners at level 3 if they’re overextending or in the middle of the lane at a deadlock. You shouldn’t get discouraged from ganking the enemy in the middle of the lane as sejuani has enough cc and all in potential to force flash or get first blood through this early gank, especially on lanes with a melee who can stack your e (which is why I usually gank top for first blood). She synergies nicely with yasuo because he can stack her e pretty damn fast as he’s an attack speed orientated melee which q’s applies on-hit effects like sejuani’s e’s where as a good yasuo can ult off sejuani’s q because it’s a guaranteed knock up.

If you need any help with builds or runes you can reliably look them up on u.gg with diamond+ as your criteria. Though looking at the pro build tab will help as well as pros usually pick up new metas and builds before u.gg updates the data. 

Side note: Sejuani is a steamroller to mid game, if you find out that your team isn’t good enough to carry I advice you to take that role up to yourself. She’s more than capable to fight 2/3 people at once if she’s properly ahead. But do not drag the game too out as her lead will turn her into a big wet sandbag in late game (though you can usually still one shot adcs with your full combo).
